be good at…: My sister is good at math, so she often helps her classmates.
我姐姐擅长数学,所以她经常帮助同学。
talk to …: You can talk to your teacher if you have any problems.
有问题的话,你可以跟老师说。
play the drums: He plays the drums in the school band every Friday afternoon.
他每周五下午在学校乐队里敲鼓。
play the piano: She plays the piano for an hour before she does her homework.
她弹一个小时钢琴,然后才做作业。
play the violin: The girl can play the violin very well for her age.
这个女孩在她这个年纪小提琴拉得非常好。
be good with…: Our new teacher is good with children and never gets angry.
我们的新老师善于应付孩子,从不生气。
make friends: It is easy to make friends when you are kind to others.
当你对别人友善时,结交朋友很容易。
help (sb) with sth: Could you help me with my English homework tonight?
今晚你能帮我做英语作业吗?
on the weekend: We usually visit my grandparents on the weekend.
我们通常在周末去看望祖父母。
get dressed: He gets dressed quickly and runs to catch the school bus.
他飞快地穿好衣服,跑去赶校车。
take a shower: I take a shower every morning before I go to school.
我每天早上上学前洗个淋浴。
radio station: She works at a radio station and loves her job there.
她在一家广播电台工作,并且热爱那里的工作。
on weekends: On weekends, the children like to fly kites in the park.
周末,孩子们喜欢在公园里放风筝。
do (one’s) homework: Tom always does his homework carefully before he watches TV.
汤姆总是先认真做完作业再看电视。
take a walk: After dinner, my parents like to take a walk along the river.
晚饭后,我父母喜欢沿着河边散步。
Either…or ……: You can take either the bus or the subway to the museum.
你要么坐公共汽车,要么坐地铁去博物馆。
take the subway: I take the subway to work because it is fast and cheap.
我乘地铁上班,因为它又快又便宜。
ride a bike: My brother learned to ride a bike when he was six.
我哥哥六岁时就学会了骑自行车。
every day: She practices speaking English every day to improve quickly.
她每天练习说英语,以便快速提高。
by bike: It takes about twenty minutes to get to school by bike.
骑自行车到学校大约需要二十分钟。
think of: What do you think of the new library in our school?
你觉得我们学校的新图书馆怎么样?
between… and…: The bank is between the bookstore and the post office.
银行在书店和邮局之间。
come true: If you work hard, your dream will come true one day.
如果你努力,你的梦想总有一天会实现。
(be) on time: Please be on time for the meeting tomorrow morning.
请明天早上准时参加会议。
listen to…: The students listen to the tape and repeat the sentences after it.
学生们听录音,然后跟读句子。
go out: I can't go out tonight because I have a lot of homework.
今晚我不能外出,因为我有很多作业。
do the dishes: After supper, the children take turns to do the dishes.
晚饭后,孩子们轮流清洗餐具。
make (one’s) bed: Remember to make your bed before you leave the room.
离开房间前记得把床铺好。
be strict (with sb): Our English teacher is strict with us, but we all like her.
我们英语老师对我们要求严格,但我们都喜欢她。
follow the rules: Everyone in the school must follow the rules, including the teachers.
学校里的每个人都必须遵守规则,包括老师。
kind of: I'm kind of tired today, so let's meet tomorrow instead.
我今天有点累,所以我们改天见吧。
South Africa: His uncle traveled to South Africa to see wild animals last year.
他叔叔去年去南非看野生动物了。
get lost: They got lost in the forest, but a farmer helped them out.
他们在森林里迷路了,但一位农夫帮助他们脱困。
be in (great) danger: These animals are in great danger because their homes are disappearing.
这些动物处于极大的危险之中,因为它们的家园正在消失。
cut down: We should cut down the number of cars to keep the air clean.
我们应该减少汽车数量来保持空气清洁。
(be) made of: The desk in my room is made of wood.
我房间里的书桌是木头做的。
read a newspaper: My grandfather reads a newspaper every morning with his glasses on.
我爷爷每天早上戴着眼镜看报纸。
make soup: Mom is making chicken soup in the kitchen right now.
妈妈现在正在厨房做鸡汤。
go to movies: We often go to movies on Friday nights with our friends.
我们经常周五晚上和朋友一起去看电影。
eat out: The family likes to eat out at a small restaurant on Saturdays.
这家人喜欢周六在一家小餐馆出去吃饭。
